lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with smaller, denser clusters near the head transitioning to larger, more widely spaced spots posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a subtle grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a distinct vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadowed drop-off on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-luminance silhouette (commensal organism) is visible attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
